paper_record.title: Néel-Vector-Dependent Altermagnetic Spin Splitting in the One-Dimensional Limit
paper_record.abstract: Altermagnetism is normally identified by nonrelativistic spin-split bands in a compensated collinear magnet. Under one-dimensional confinement, however, this diagnostic can disappear: a boundary-compatible sublattice-exchange operation may leave the only Bloch momentum unchanged, forcing the nonrelativistic spin-up and spin-down spectra to coincide. We show that nonrelativistic spin degeneracy can coexist with relativistic spin splitting in a compensated one-dimensional magnet. In a Lieb-based construction, confinement along the diagonal cancels the projected $d$-wave spin splitting while preserving the real-space sublattice-exchange motif. Spin-orbit coupling (SOC) then locks spin to the lattice, so the Néel-vector orientation selects a magnetic line group that can reveal spin-split bands. Using fully compensated $[110]$ Ta$_2$TeSeO nanoribbons as a prototype, we find spin-degenerate nonrelativistic bands and sizable SOC splitting in the inherited easy-axis domain, $\mathbf N\parallel[100]$ or $[010]$. For sufficiently wide ribbons that retain the parent easy-axis order, this splitting is an equilibrium property. The easy-axis ribbon also supports a right-moving-mode spin polarization of about $35\%$ at finite ideal conductance. Our results establish one-dimensional fully compensated altermagnetic functionality hidden inside apparently conventional antiferromagnetic bands.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 本文揭示了一维受限磁性体系中，非相对论能带简并与自旋轨道耦合诱导的自旋劈裂可以共存，从而实现一维交错磁性功能。
one_sentence_summary.en: This paper demonstrates that nonrelativistic spin degeneracy and SOC-induced spin splitting can coexist in one-dimensional confined magnets, enabling 1D altermagnetic functionality.

problem.zh: 在一维受限条件下，交错磁性材料中通常会导致能带自旋劈裂的对称性操作失效，使得体系在非相对论极限下表现为普通的自旋简并反铁磁体。
problem.en: In one-dimensional confinement, the symmetry operations that typically cause spin splitting in altermagnets become trivial, making the system appear as a spin-degenerate antiferromagnet in the nonrelativistic spectrum.

approach.zh: 通过构建基于Lieb晶格的Ta2TeSeO纳米带模型，利用自旋轨道耦合（SOC）锁定自旋与晶格，通过改变尼尔矢量方向来打破简并，并结合第一性原理计算验证。
approach.en: Constructing a Lieb-lattice-based Ta2TeSeO nanoribbon model, using SOC to lock spin to the lattice, breaking degeneracy via Néel vector orientation, and validating with first-principles calculations.

main_takeaway.zh: 一维交错磁性可以通过SOC诱导的能带劈裂实现，且其自旋响应高度依赖于尼尔矢量的取向。
main_takeaway.en: 1D altermagnetic functionality can be realized through SOC-induced band splitting, with spin responses highly dependent on the Néel vector orientation.

why_it_matters.zh: 该研究证明了即使在非相对论能带表现为简并的一维体系中，依然可以挖掘出隐藏的交错磁性，为一维自旋电子学器件提供了新思路。
why_it_matters.en: It proves that hidden altermagnetism can be exploited in 1D systems even when nonrelativistic bands appear degenerate, offering new possibilities for 1D spintronic devices.

reason.zh: 明确了一维受限下交错磁性与自旋轨道耦合相互作用的物理机制。
reason.en: It clarifies the physical mechanism of the interaction between altermagnetism and spin-orbit coupling under 1D confinement.

reason.zh: 该领域典型的理论与材料计算研究，符合PRB的发表范畴。
reason.en: Typical theoretical and computational material research in this field, fitting the scope of PRB.
